query.text: 请帮我留意院子，有大型野生动物进入时及时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please monitor the yard and tell me when a large wild animal enters.

annotation.text_zh: 警告：有一只黑熊正走入您的车道，请注意安全，避免外出。
annotation.text_en: Warning: A black bear is walking into your driveway. Please stay safe and avoid going outside.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
